source.quote: The Firm repurchased $1.5 billion of its outstanding common stock during the quarter
The Board of Directors declared a $1.15 quarterly dividend per share, an increase of 15 cents
The Standardized Common Equity Tier 1 capital ratio was 14.8%.
The Firm delivered a strong ROTCE of 26.6%.
